# Peak Legacy Hardware

Peak Legacy Hardware is a building materials, finishes and construction solutions business in Nyahururu, Kenya.

Website: https://peaklegacy.co.ke/
WhatsApp: +254 791 229 945
Location: Nyahururu, Kenya
Tagline: Build. Finish. Deliver.

Core product areas: cabro paving, tiles, doors, sanitary ware, stone and Mazeras cladding, cement and building essentials, gypsum and interior finishing materials, roofing, plumbing, electrical and general hardware.

Services: construction, architectural design, quantity surveying, interior design, cabro installation and delivery.

Current prices and availability should be confirmed with Peak Legacy before purchase.
